inspections.name: header contract
inspections.detail: complete typedef ImageData is independently defined in both src/consumer.h and src/producer.h; keep one canonical definition and include its owning header

inspections.name: callback-abi
inspections.detail: parser.c assigns help_callback to G_OPTION_ARG_CALLBACK, but its definition does not match gboolean (const gchar *, const gchar *, gpointer, GError **); arg_data erases this type and ordinary compiler pointer warnings cannot validate it

inspections.name: publish-result
inspections.detail: gdk_clipboard_set_content returns gboolean but its result is ignored; branch on failure before reporting or scheduling successful delivery

inspections.name: idle-source-id
inspections.detail: g_idle_add/g_idle_add_full is compared with zero as though scheduling could fail; GLib guarantees a source ID greater than zero, so this branch is unreachable and must not be used as an error or synchronous fallback path

inspections.name: channel-mask-flow
inspections.detail: red channel width is counted from the unshifted mask; a low-bit counter returns zero for shifted fields such as 0xff0000. Count width from (red_mask >> red_shift) or from the mask after removing trailing zeroes
